verdict.rationale: BugSnag documents snooze and ignore error statuses, which give it mute/ignore rules, and it groups events so one issue does not fan out into many. Its event-usage controls and daily quota overage options give some say over which events are saved and counted, but the evidence never describes these as alert throttling. missing for 10: explicit spike protection, per-key or per-project rate limits on alerts/notifications, documented controls on how often PagerDuty or Slack alerts fire during a bad deploy, and independent hands-on corroboration.
